body:
174Hz is one of the most grounding and stabilizing frequencies, known for supporting tension release, physical relaxation, and energetic safety. This Frequency Ring was designed to help the body and field unwind from accumulated stress.

Solid Copper at the center conducts and amplifies the frequency, while Clear Quartz anchors both ends for balance and amplification. Peach Moonstone gently soothes emotional tension and supports nervous system relaxation. Black Agate and Black Tourmaline ground excess energy and provide deep energetic protection.

Red Tiger’s Eye restores strength and resilience, helping the body feel supported rather than depleted. Silver-Sheen Obsidian works at a deeper level, helping release stored tension and energetic residue from stress or overwhelm.

Wrapped in gold wire, the ring creates a continuous frequency circuit that allows the energy to flow steadily throughout your day.

Charge this ring regularly on your 174Hz Frequency Generator for optimal stress-relief support.
